summary: Alpine assisted Mountain Rescue Aspen with a search on 10/11/14 for two hikers on Maroon Peak (Alpine mission 14-112) — the subjects were Vail climbers Jarod Wetherell, 37, found deceased Oct 10 in the Rock Glacier area of North Maroon Peak (HAATS helicopter extrication), and David Richardson, 32, found injured Oct 10 in the Bell Chord area on the east aspect; reported overdue the evening of Oct 8 after summiting one of the Maroon Bells around noon Wednesday; PCSO + MRA ground search Oct 9, helicopter search Oct 10
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen; Alpine Rescue Team (assist); Colorado National Guard HAATS helicopter
notes: Alpine Rescue Team 2014 annual mission summary PDF (one-line mission log; page date used as mission date). Run 452 merge: Real Vail (opened) + SnowBrains (search-index) coverage of the same search — names and outcomes (Wetherell deceased, Richardson injured with broken bone per SnowBrains; cause undetermined, no route identified), Oct 8 ~10pm overdue report, Oct 9 ground search, Oct 10 HAATS helicopter find; outcome corrected from rescued-uninjured to fatality per this coverage. MERGE run 825: appended RealVail Oct-10-2014 'search underway' PCSO press-release piece (parent-opened).
